description: **Preempt a conversation's write lock.** DSH's write lock is a cross-process kernel semaphore that never expires while its holder lives, and no API can take it away: the only means is killing the holder, so this tool first works out who that is. (1) If the lock is actually free, a normal resume follows and nothing is killed. (2) If the holder is **an orphan this server left behind**, its OS start time must match the registration before takeover. (3) Another live dsh-any-agent instance also requires force=true. (4) If the holder is unknown, or its start time is missing or differs from the registration, release the conversation in its original host and retry. Killing a holder that is running a turn interrupts that turn (logged as interrupted); the conversation itself is unharmed.

conversation_id.description: Conversation id, from dsh_start or dsh_list.

force.description: Allow takeover from another live instance or a shared child process. The lock holder’s process identity still has to be verified.

name: dsh_takeover
title: Take over write lock
